description: ASTRA Stable — single source of truth for ports. No service may invent its own port. Legacy ports are listed in `aliases` and must never be used again.

astra-api.name: Astra API
astra-api.notes: Orchestrator front door. ASTRA_API_PORT / ASTRA_ADAPTER_BASE_URL point here.

astra-ui.name: Astra UI (Vite)
astra-ui.notes: Browser app. Must render even if every AI/extension service is down.

freellmapi.name: FreeLLMAPI gateway
freellmapi.notes: CANONICAL 31416 (was 3001 in ecosystem + ai-gateway.env -> that split is the root of the offline/degraded reports).

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.notes: Local last-resort route. Must be probed by every watchdog.

voicebox.name: Voicebox
voicebox.notes: PM2 must own voicebox-server.exe directly. Never `start /min` (detaches -> unmanaged).

laya.name: Laya decision nucleus
laya.notes: Existing loopback. Registered here so the port is not invented a second time.

voicebox-bridge.name: Voicebox MCP bridge
voicebox-bridge.notes: Optional. Reserved so nothing else claims it.

notPm2Services.gesture: Saarathi Gesture Vision was removed. Do not register a gesture process with PM2.
